async def act(page):
    # Enter the phone number into the search textbox
    search_box = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search by keyword")
    await search_box.fill("555-229-3326")
    # Click the Search button to filter the table
    search_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for the table to update
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Check if any rows with the phone number appear in the table
    # Look for a cell containing the phone number 555-229-3326
    phone_cell = page.get_by_role("cell", name="555-229-3326", exact=True)
    try:
        await phone_cell.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
        # If found, get the row containing this cell
        # Use .nth() to navigate within the row based on cell order
        row = phone_cell.locator("xpath=./ancestor::tr")  # Move up to the row (tr) parent using XPath as allowed for parent navigation
        # Get the name and email cells using .nth() on the row's cells
        name_cell = row.get_by_role("cell").nth(1)  # Second cell in row (Name)
        email_cell = row.get_by_role("cell").nth(2)  # Third cell in row (Email)
        name = await name_cell.text_content()
        email = await email_cell.text_content()
        result = f"Name: {name}, Email: {email}"
        print(result)
    except:
        # If not found, print a message indicating no customer found
        print("No customer found with phone number 555-229-3326.")
